**STEP 1 - Scene:** A small lunch plate: one wedge of tomato-and-mozzarella pizza (margherita style) beside a side salad of rocket/arugula with cucumber and a few small diced pieces.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** A white square plate, about 26 cm across, so area ≈ 530 cm². The pizza slice sits on the plate edge at lower right, but it is part of this meal.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Pizza wedge (tomato sauce, melted mozzarella, crust)
- Rocket/arugula leaves
- Cucumber slice
- A few small yellow pieces (likely corn kernels)

**STEP 4 - Area (% of plate):**
- Pizza wedge: ~15% (about 80 cm²)
- Rocket leaves: ~18% (about 95 cm²)
- Cucumber: ~2% (about 10 cm²)
- Corn/other bits: ~1% (about 5 cm²)
- Total food coverage: ~36%, which is plausible for a partly filled plate.

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Pizza: 80 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Leaves: 95 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 285 ml
- Cucumber: 10 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 10 ml
- Corn/other: 5 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 3 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Pizza: 96 ml × 0.95 ≈ 91 g, rounded to 95 g
- Leaves: 285 ml × 0.15 ≈ 43 g
- Cucumber: 10 ml × 0.6 ≈ 6 g
- Corn/other: 3 ml × 0.7 ≈ 2 g
- Total ≈ 146 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Pizza: 95 g × 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 247 kcal
- Leaves: 43 g × 25 kcal/100 g ≈ 11 kcal
- Cucumber: 6 g × 15 kcal/100 g ≈ 1 kcal
- Corn/other: 2 g × 90 kcal/100 g ≈ 2 kcal
- Total ≈ 261 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 146 g and roughly 260 kcal fits a single pizza wedge plus a small side salad, with the plate about one-third covered. The pizza accounts for most of the energy.
